question_en: What is the IMD rainfall forecast for the 2025 Kharif monsoon season across India?
expected_answer: IMD forecasts an above-normal monsoon season with cumulative rainfall expected at 106% of the Long Period Average (LPA) of 87 cm.
notes: Direct factual extraction from national introduction.

question_en: What government initiative delivers hyper-local weather forecasts at the panchayat level for farmers?
expected_answer: The Panchayat Mausam Seva initiative delivers hyper-local weather forecasts at the panchayat level.

question_en: What spacing and pit enrichment are recommended for establishing a new coconut plantation in island conditions?
expected_answer: Plant 10-12 month-old healthy, disease-free seedlings at 7.5 m x 7.5 m spacing in 1 m x 1 m x 1 m pits enriched with organic matter such as compost or farmyard manure.

question_en: How can rhinoceros beetles be managed in coconut palms during the Kharif season?
expected_answer: Place naphthalene balls (3-4 g/palm) in the leaf axils and deploy pheromone or bio-traps to attract and control the beetles.
notes: Bio-physical management of coconut rhinoceros beetle.

question_en: Which organic manures and biofertilizers are recommended per vine annually for black pepper?
expected_answer: Apply 10 kg FYM, 1 kg neem cake, 1 kg wood ash, and 2 kg vermicompost per vine annually, along with 50 g each of Azospirillum and phosphorus-solubilizing bacteria (PSB).
notes: Detailed nutrient management for spice crop.

question_en: How should farmers manage drenched harvested paddy sheaves during unexpected rainy weather to prevent seed germination?
expected_answer: Spray a 5% salt solution on drenched sheaves to prevent seed germination, turn them over, dry, and thresh them after cessation of rain.

question_en: What is the recommended herbicide for controlling grassy, sedge, and broadleaf weeds in transplanted paddy within 3 to 5 days of planting?
expected_answer: Apply Pyrazosulfuron-ethyl 10 WP at 200-250 g/ha mixed with 50 kg sand, or Butachlor 50 EC at 2.5-3.0 L/ha, or Pretilachlor 50 EC at 1000 ml/ha in shallow standing water.

question_en: How should potash fertilizer be split for transplanted rice in light soils?
expected_answer: In light soils, apply half the potash dose during puddling and the remaining half at the panicle initiation stage.
notes: Split application timing for potash in light soils.

question_en: What post-emergence herbicide should be applied for grassy weed control in paddy 15-20 days after transplanting?
expected_answer: Apply Cyhalofop-p-butyl 10 EC at 1000 ml/ha at 15-20 days after transplanting.

question_en: What fungicides prevent grain discoloration when paddy is submerged in water during boot leaf or flowering stage?
expected_answer: Spray Carbendazim at 1 g/L, Carbendazim + Mancozeb at 2 g/L, or Propiconazole at 1 ml/L.

question_en: What is the recommended seed rate for normal hybrid maize and sweet corn in rainfed Kharif cultivation?
expected_answer: Seed rate is 15-20 kg/ha for normal hybrids and 8-10 kg/ha for sweet corn.

question_en: What pre-emergence herbicide should be sprayed within 2-3 days after sowing maize to control broadleaf and grassy weeds?
expected_answer: Spray Atrazine 50% WP at 2 kg/ha in light soils and 3 kg/ha in heavy soils mixed with 500 liters of water when soil moisture is adequate.

question_en: What insecticide spray is recommended when Fall Armyworm (FAW) is observed in maize at 15-20 days after sowing?
expected_answer: First insecticide spray at 15-20 DAS is Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG at 0.4 g/L or Spinosad 45 SC at 0.3 ml/L.
notes: Specific pest threshold management for FAW.

question_en: What is the optimum sowing window for rainfed groundnut in Andhra Pradesh?
expected_answer: The suitable time for sowing rainfed groundnut is July to the first week of August.

question_en: How can Tikka leaf spot be controlled in groundnut?
expected_answer: Spray 2 g Chlorothalonil, 1 ml Hexaconazole, or 1 ml Tebuconazole per liter of water twice at an interval of 10-15 days.
notes: Chemical control for fungal Tikka leaf spot.

question_en: What seed treatment is recommended to prevent necrosis virus in sunflower?
expected_answer: Treat seeds with Thiamethoxam 70 WS (Cruiser) at 5 g/kg seed or Imidacloprid (Gaucho) at 5 g/kg seed.

question_en: What fertilizer dose and application timing are advised for sunflower in sulphur-deficient soils?
expected_answer: Apply 12 kg urea at sowing, 12 kg at 30 days (bud stage), and 6 kg at 45 days (flowering), full dose of 125 kg SSP and 20 kg MOP at final ploughing, plus 12 kg sulphur in gypsum form (60 kg/acre).

question_en: What is the recommended seed rate and spacing for castor in Andhra Pradesh?
expected_answer: Seed rate is 2.5-3.0 kg/acre with spacing of 90 cm x 60 cm, thinned at 15-20 DAS to maintain one seedling per hill.

question_en: What seed sett treatment is recommended for sugarcane to eliminate pineapple disease and scale insects?
expected_answer: Dip three-budded setts in Carbendazim (0.5 g/L) or Dimethoate (1.5 ml/L) or Imidacloprid 70 FS (0.1 ml/L) for 15 minutes before planting.

question_en: What row spacing is recommended for early and mid-late sugarcane varieties to allow mechanization?
expected_answer: 80 cm between rows for early varieties, 90 cm for mid-late varieties, or paired row planting (60 cm x 120 cm) to promote mechanization and drip irrigation.

question_en: Why is intercropping sorghum with redgram (pigeonpea) recommended in rainfed conditions?
topic: Crop selection and suitable growing conditions
expected_answer: Following a 2:1 ratio of jowar-redgram intercropping reduces wilt incidence in pigeonpea, enhances growth and productivity, and stabilizes economic returns.

question_en: What seed treatment and seed rate are recommended for pearl millet (bajra) in Andhra Pradesh?
expected_answer: Seed rate is 1.5-2.0 kg/acre with 45 cm x 15 cm spacing. Soak seeds in 20% salt water for 10 minutes to remove floating ergot material, dry, and treat with metalaxyl (6 g/kg seed).
notes: Specific brine flotation and fungicidal seed treatment.

question_en: Which foxtail millet varieties can be grown as a preceding Kharif crop before Rabi chickpea in black soils?
topic: Crop selection and suitable growing conditions
expected_answer: High-yielding foxtail millet varieties include SIA 3088, Renadu, Mahanandi, and Garuda (SIA 3156).

question_en: What mobile application facilitates drone-based spraying of IFFCO nano fertilizers for farmers?
expected_answer: The IFFCO Kisan Drone app facilitates booking, viewing, and management of drone-based spraying of nano fertilizers and QR code scanning.

question_en: What nursery area and seedling density are required for transplanting one hectare of rice in Assam?
expected_answer: A 1000 sq m nursery area is sufficient for transplanting one hectare of land, transplanting 2-3 seedlings per hill at 20 cm x 15 cm spacing (33 hills/sq m) for semi-dwarf varieties.

question_en: Why should leaf tips of rice seedlings be clipped during transplanting?
expected_answer: Clipping of leaf tips during transplanting removes egg masses laid by stem borer.

question_en: What is the recommended sowing depth and spacing for maize in the North Eastern hill region?
expected_answer: Seeds should be dibbled at a depth of 3-5 cm with row-to-row spacing of 60-75 cm and plant-to-plant spacing of 20-25 cm.

question_en: How many Apis cerana bee colonies per hectare are recommended for effective pollination and productivity in sesame?
topic: Crop selection and suitable growing conditions
expected_answer: Five Apis cerana colonies per hectare (1 colony per bigha) should be installed for effective pollination of sesame.

question_en: What organic and bio-control measure controls fruit fly in pumpkin?
expected_answer: Apply neem cake at 100 kg/acre immediately after germination and repeat at flowering, followed by spraying 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or Azadirachtin 1500 ppm at 3 ml/L.

question_en: How can yellow mosaic virus spread be checked in black gram (urdbean)?
expected_answer: Place yellow sticky traps (4-5 per acre) to capture whiteflies and spray 5% neem seed kernel extract or Azadirachtin 1500 ppm at 3 ml/L.

question_en: What chemical spray is recommended if whitefly infestation in King Chilli exceeds economic threshold levels?
expected_answer: If whitefly infestation exceeds ETL, spray Buprofezin at 1 ml/L at weekly intervals.

question_en: What is the recommended plant spacing and seed rate for brinjal cultivation in the North Eastern hills?
expected_answer: Seed rate is 370-500 g/ha with ideal spacing of 75 cm row-to-row and 60 cm plant-to-plant.

question_en: At what age should chicks be vaccinated against Ranikhet disease?
expected_answer: Vaccinate birds against Ranikhet disease at 5-7 days of age and repeat when chicks become 28-30 days old.

question_en: Which submergence-tolerant rice varieties are recommended for flash-flood prone areas of Assam?
topic: Crop selection and suitable growing conditions
expected_answer: Submergence-tolerant rice varieties for flash-flood situations are Ranjit Sub-1, Bahadur Sub-1, Jalashree, Jalkunwari, and Dholi.
notes: Varieties adapted to climate flash floods.

question_en: How should paddy seed be treated using wet method to prevent fungal diseases in Assam?
expected_answer: Soak selected sunken seeds in a fungicidal suspension of Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% at 2 g/L of water for 24 hours (1 liter fungicide solution per kg of seed).

question_en: How should farmers collect soil samples from vacant fields after the Rabi harvest for nutrient analysis?
expected_answer: Remove surface debris, collect soil up to 15 cm depth for shallow-rooted crops in a zig-zag manner collecting 10-15 sub-samples per unit, mix thoroughly, discard foreign materials, and quarter down to 0.5-1.0 kg.

question_en: What method is recommended for low-cost rainwater harvesting during dry spells in Himachal Pradesh?
expected_answer: Construct a low-cost silpaulin-lined pond in a low-lying area to minimize seepage and store rainwater for irrigation during lean dry periods.

question_en: What is the recommended sowing method, depth, and seed rate for maize in Himachal Pradesh?
expected_answer: Optimum seed rate is 20 kg/ha sown at 3-5 cm depth using Kera method (behind the plough) at 60 cm row-to-row and 20 cm plant-to-plant spacing.

question_en: Which red rice varieties are recommended for upland and irrigated transplanted conditions in Himachal Pradesh?
topic: Crop selection and suitable growing conditions
expected_answer: Red rice varieties are HPR 2720 for upland areas and HPR 2795 for irrigated transplanted areas, sown by mid-June.
notes: Hill specialty red rice varietal selection.

question_en: How should cutworm and white grub be controlled prior to maize sowing in Himachal Pradesh?
expected_answer: Apply Chlorpyriphos 20 EC at 2.5 L/ha mixed in 100 kg sandy soil for soil amendment before sowing, or spray Cypermethrin 10 EC at 1.0 ml/L.

question_en: What herbicide and dose are recommended for weed control within 48 hours of transplanting rice in Himachal Pradesh?
expected_answer: Apply Butachlor 50 EC at 3.0 L/ha mixed with sand or broadcast Butachlor granules at 30 kg/ha within 48 hours of transplanting.

question_en: At what stage should paddy be harvested based on grain colour?
expected_answer: Harvesting of paddy is generally done when 80-85% of the grains turn straw-coloured.

question_en: How should stem borer be controlled in rice using standing water treatment?
expected_answer: Apply Cartap hydrochloride 4G at 10 kg/acre in 4-5 cm standing water without draining or irrigating for 48 hours.

question_en: What seed rate and corm management are required for saffron cultivation?
expected_answer: Saffron requires 30-40 q corms/acre with deep ploughing, raised beds, disease-free corms, and fertigation using 20 kg Urea, 30 kg DAP, and 20 kg MOP.

question_en: Which fodder varieties of Bajra and Jowar are recommended for Jammu and Kashmir?
topic: Crop selection and suitable growing conditions
expected_answer: Giant Bajra, FBC 16, PCB 164 for Bajra; MP Chari, Haryana Chari-51, and Proagro Chari SSG-59-3 for Jowar.

question_en: How can zinc and magnesium deficiency be corrected in fruit plants?
expected_answer: Spray 500 g Zinc Sulphate, 500 g Magnesium Sulphate, and 250 g lime in 100 L water every 15 days.

question_en: What spray prevents flower and fruit drop in chillies at full bloom?
expected_answer: Spray 20 ppm NAA (Naphthalene Acetic Acid) at full bloom stage.

question_en: How can fruit cracking caused by boron deficiency be prevented in tomato?
expected_answer: Apply Borax spray at 0.3-0.4% in nursery, and at 4-5 and 7-8 weeks after transplanting.

notes: Unanswerable from source. Document covers field and orchard crops but lacks commercial polyhouse strawberry subsidy or fertigation guidelines for Karnataka.
